name: Independent replication of neutral blood exchange in aged mice, then a plasma-exchange trial

design.intervention: neutral blood exchange (saline-albumin); then therapeutic plasma exchange
design.comparator: heterochronic exchange; sham apheresis in the human stage
design.readout: muscle repair, cognition and frailty measures in mice; gait speed, cognition and inflammatory markers in humans

discriminates: Replication would make plasma exchange the fastest testable rejuvenation intervention, because the procedure already exists; failure to replicate would send the field back to identifying factors.

requires: apheresis service for the human stage
feasibility.ethics: animal and human research ethics approval

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
